reports.blind_spot_notes: Brighton (home vs Leeds, Sat) is carrying a genuinely alarming injury list right now -- Hinshelwood (6 weeks), Minteh, Mitoma, Wieffer, Tzimas, Ferguson all out, Rutter/Ayari doubtful -- yet the market still has them near even-money favorites off their historical Amex dominance over Leeds (unbeaten in 10 at home, 8 straight clean sheets there). That home record was built with a healthy attack; this one is not healthy. Didn't clear 60% either direction to make it a formal pick, but it looked mispriced enough to flag. Similarly Crystal Palace (away at Fulham) just lost Mateta (hamstring, out into October) on top of Riad's ACL -- their already-worst-in-the-slate defense (6 conceded in 2 games) now has no reliable outlet up top either.
reports.lsu_review_notes: Kept the Man City pick to the match-result market, not the -2.5 spread -- Rodri's absence (no return date) is real enough that I don'd trust City to cover a 3-goal margin as much as I trust them to simply win. No home-cooking on Hull City either: the pick is off the actual clean-sheet form and Villa's zero-shots-on-target start, not a hunch.
